candidates.title: [Feature]: Explicitly trust a selected preload daemon to avoid checkpoint rescans on engine restart
candidates.snippet: ### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch  When an engine starts with `--load-format ipc_cache`, it computes the checkpoint fingerprint again before requesting weights from a preload daemon. On a high-latency filesystem, that scan can take a meaningful fraction of every engine restart even when the operator intends to reuse the same already-loaded daemon. candidates.title: [Draft] [RFC]: Support dispatcher-native token dropping for MoE expert capacity
candidates.snippet: # [RFC]: Support dispatcher-native token dropping for MoE expert capacity  ## Motivation  Expert-capacity token dropping limits the assignments retained by each MoE expert. This reduces activation and scratch memory at the cost of changing model output.  This RFC proposes optional expert capacity for modular MoE kernels, implemented natively by dispatchers rather than as Python-side compaction and restoration. candidates.title: Qwen3.5 4B returns thinking-only responses for a long conversation on Ollama 0.40.2
candidates.snippet: ### What is the issue?  ## Observed behavior  The installed stock `qwen3.5:4b`, with request-local `options.num_ctx:65536`, returns HTTP 200 and completes with `done:true`, `done_reason:"stop"`, and positive `eval_count`, but only `message.thinking`: no content or tool calls. The attached anonymized request reproduced this **3/3 sequential runs directly against Ollama**, without VS Code, Copilot, or the extension provider.  Expected: a visible answer to the completed task, or a tool call if more
